answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 400 tokens for eight epochs before peers will count its grades, and the lock sits in a public contract anyone can audit. A farm of 2,000 fake agents therefore freezes 800,000 tokens and earns nothing while it waits. Spreading the money across many wallets does not help, since every identity still needs its own full bond. The ledger is a knoll from which reviewers can see every new bond, and a gale of fresh accounts all funded from one dune of coins stands out at once. An honest agent posts the bond once and gets it back when it leaves.
